name: Patents Phrase to Phrase Semantic Matching Dataset
description: There are many general purpose benchmark datasets for Semantic Textual Similarity but none of them are focused on technical concepts found in patents and scientific publications. This work aims to fill this gap by presenting a new human rated contextual phrase to phrase matching dataset. The entire dataset contains close to $50,000$ rated phrase pairs, each with a CPC (Cooperative Patent Classification) class as a context. This paper describes the dataset and some baseline models.
evaluation_method: Pearson correlation, Spearman correlation, and MSE
typical_sota_score: 0.70–0.85 (Pearson/Spearman correlation range reported by recent strong semantic-similarity models)
reputation: A domain-specific semantic similarity dataset for patents and scientific text, useful for technical phrase matching but not a mainstream general-purpose benchmark.
notes: Human-rated phrase pairs with CPC context; primarily a regression-style STS benchmark and smaller/narrower than general STS datasets.
